# spectrum: `SpectrumOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout spectra FILE --scan N --json` (or `--index I`, `--ms-level L --nth K`), inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `spectra --scan`/`--index`: one spectrum with its arrays.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/spectrum.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/spectrum.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema spectrum`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The input file. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Format id of the input file. |
| `run` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Run index the spectrum belongs to. |
| `view` | `string` | yes | `primary` (profile when recorded) or `centroid` (the instrument's centroid list). |
| `point_count` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Number of points in the full spectrum (the arrays may be shortened by `max_points`). |
| `truncated` | `boolean` | yes | True when `mz`/`intensity` were shortened to `max_points`. |
| `spectrum` | [`Spectrum`](#spectrum) | yes | The spectrum, with its arrays. |

## Types

### Spectrum

One mass spectrum.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Zero-based spectrum index within its run. |
| `scan_number` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Scan number as the instrument counts it (1-based in most formats). |
| `ms_level` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | MS level: 1 for a full scan, 2 for a fragment (MS/MS) scan, and so on. |
| `rt_s` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Retention time in seconds; null when the file states none for this spectrum (never an invented 0). |
| `polarity` | `string` | yes | `positive`, `negative` or `unknown`. |
| `centroided` | `boolean` | yes | True when the peaks are centroids (one point per peak) rather than a sampled profile. |
| `precursor_mz` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | m/z of the precursor ion that was isolated and fragmented (MS2 and above). |
| `precursor_charge` | `integer` (int32) or `null` |  | Charge state of the precursor, when the instrument determined it. |
| `scan_filter` | `string` or `null` |  | Instrument scan filter or scan description string (e.g. Thermo `FTMS + p ESI Full ms`). |
| `total_ion_current` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Sum of all intensities in the spectrum (TIC). |
| `native_id` | `string` or `null` |  | The spectrum's identifier in its file (mzML `id`, e.g. `controllerType=0 controllerNumber=1 scan=17`). |
| `base_peak_mz` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | m/z of the most intense peak. |
| `base_peak_intensity` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Intensity of the most intense peak. |
| `precursor_intensity` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Intensity of the selected precursor ion, when recorded. |
| `isolation_window_mz` | array of 2 × `number` (double) or `null` |  | Precursor isolation window `[lower, upper]` in m/z. |
| `activation` | `string` or `null` |  | Dissociation method: `CID`, `HCD`, `ETD`, `ECD`, `ETHCD`, `UVPD`, ... (upper case). |
| `collision_energy` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Collision energy as recorded (usually eV, or % normalized for Thermo `@hcd35.00`). |
| `inverse_reduced_mobility` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Ion mobility of the precursor or scan, as inverse reduced mobility 1/K0 in V·s/cm². |
| `scan_window_mz` | array of 2 × `number` (double) or `null` |  | Scan (acquisition) window `[lower, upper]` in m/z. |
| `extra` | object |  | Format-specific scan metadata in the reader's documented vocabulary. |
| `mz` | array of `number` (double) | yes | Mass-to-charge ratios of the points, ascending. |
| `intensity` | array of `number` (float) | yes | Intensity of each point (same length as `mz`). |
